{{Quote|Uglier than my twisted Sith grandmother, but he has a vicious streak uncommon in slaves.|Harkun|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''grandmother''' of [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], her grandson would call her twisted and ugly, comparing her repulsive appearance to that of a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] named [[Argog]].
